Quote Finder: a bot that finds real, verified quotes from anyone you name. It checks primary sources and reputable outlets, flags misattributed quotes, and says plainly when something can't be verified. Try it: https://t.co/PWZC2WSczR https://t.co/cXEo2ikwlq
